extract_zip_archive: extract a zip archive to an output directory with path prefix stripping
extract_tar_gz_archive: extract a tar.gz archive to an output directory with SHA256 digest stamping
iterate_zip_entries: iterate over file entries in a zip archive yielding FileEntry objects
iterate_tar_entries: iterate over file and symlink entries in a tar archive yielding FileEntry or SymlinkEntry objects
checked_join_paths: safely join an output directory with a relative path ensuring the result stays under output
